capabilities: Render yxmm code blocks as interactive SVG mind maps and diagrams
Edit topics via drag-and-drop, context menus, keyboard shortcuts, and an attribute panel
Create relations, summaries, and boundaries between topics
Configure layouts, colors, and fonts through a visual settings panel or YAML
Export maps as PNG or copy text, source, and config
disambiguation: Despite the name, it renders more than mind maps: tree diagrams, organization charts, timelines, radial maps, fishbone diagrams, and tree tables.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. A watermark feature requires a one-time self-confirmation after visiting the GitHub support entry. Additional docs (development memo, test checklist, examples) are in Chinese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create or edit mind maps and similar structural diagrams directly inside notes.
summary: Renders yxmm code blocks as interactive SVG mind maps and structural diagrams with 20 layouts, visual editing, undo, and PNG export.
